snippet.title: [AB+] ALTEREDBLOOD+ NEW DEMO on STEAM (Gameplay Trailer / PV)
snippet.description:
SPLATTER arena walls and floors in your foe’s BLOOD. 
SOAK up BLOOD to regenerate Ammo and Health. 
STAND in that BLOOD to ALTER You and your Weapons.

Play the Demo & Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4634350/ALTEREDBLOOD_Demo/

Join our Discord community: 
https://discord.com/invite/wEEgSQ3qyp

---
3242 CE:

We launched MOTHER, a self-replicating megastructure towards the galactic centre.

4,199,245,344,263,242,348,389,893,582,349,373 CE:

MOTHER has consumed 99.99999997% of the Observable Universe.

Humanity dwells in the remaining space. 
[PARASITES] Carving into MOTHER, gorging on her BLOOD.

MOTHER created YOU to stop them.

BECKON {OUR} EXTINCTION
--
